newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania central bank backs Snoras capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania central bank backs Snoras capital rise.

text.p: Lihuania's central bank said on Wednesday that it had approved an application by one of the country's leading banks, Snoras Bank, to double its share capital.
The central bank said in a statement that Snoras was given permission to increase its share capital to 20 million litas from 10 million litas.
Snoras is one of Lithuania's largest commercial banks with assets worth 310 million litas at the end of September.
Like other banks, it has operated in a tough environment as the country shakes off the effects of a crisis sparked late last year by the closure of two of its largest banks.
